items.q: How much does piano removal cost in Nobleton?

items.q: Is my piano too small a job to bother calling about?
a: Never. A single upright prices as the modest job it is, with no minimum charge propping the invoice up.

items.q: We were planning to move the piano ourselves — why hire it out?
a: Worth doing the math first: an upright weighs 300 to 500 pounds, a grand considerably more, and the real risk of injury or damage from an improvised move usually isn’t worth the savings. Our flat quote often lands close to what a DIY rental setup would cost anyway, minus the risk.

items.q: Do you charge extra for stairs?
a: No. Narrow staircases and multi-floor moves are factored into one flat quote at the walkthrough.

items.q: Can you remove a piano the same day I call?
a: Often, yes — trucks run seven days a week, 6AM to 11PM.
